:::{#def-fold-mse-indexed}
#### Fold mean squared error of a named procedure

The **fold mean squared error of procedure** $\fitproc$ for [fold](#def-folds) $\fold{\ifold}$
of a training set $\trainset$, indexed by $\obsidx$,
is the [fold mean squared error](#def-fold-mse)
computed with the [fold-out rule](#def-fold-out-rule) that $\fitproc$ produces:

$$
\foldmseof{\ifold}{\fitproc}\paren{\trainset} \eqdef \frac{1}{\foldsize{\ifold}} \sum_{\iobs \in \fold{\ifold}}
\sqf{\fitproc\paren{\predvar_{\iobs}; \paren{(\predvar_{\iobs'}, \outvar_{\iobs'})}_{\iobs' \in \obsidx \setminus \fold{\ifold}}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}.
$$ {#eq-fold-mse-indexed}

:::
